Name: CS_TEXTURE_FILTER_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Texture filtering settings for each level of the Texture Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Texture Filter
Fields.Description: Filtering mode of the main texture samplers, 0–3; higher is better.

Fields.Name: Maximum Anisotropy
Fields.Description: Maximum anisotropic filtering level of the main texture samplers.
